name: final-boot

serve.command: exec env -i HOME=/home/spark USER=spark LOGNAME=spark PATH=/usr/local/cuda/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin RUST_BACKTRACE=1 /home/spark/inkling-2-mini-1x-dgx-spark/bin/rexl3-serve --model /home/spark/models/Inkling-2-Mini-SAGE-REXL3-4.23bpw --max-model-len 262144 --slots 4 --kv-tokens 1048576 --prefill-chunk 4096 --kv-dtype int8 --spec dspark --prefix-cache on --allow-unvalidated-pack --served-model-name inkling-2-mini-1x-dgx-spark --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000

tests.filter: doctor: node idle, MemAvailable, pack at full size, engine installed
start: /health 200, memory guard armed on the server pid, no level=fatal

commands: ./inkling2mini.sh start   (shipping defaults: SPEC=dspark PREFIX_CACHE=on VISION=on, profile bootstrap, 4 x 262,144)
notes: First boot after the build of the pin, shipping defaults, drafter dspark, prefix cache on, vision on (tower loaded). boot_s is the controller's start, doctor included, until /health answered 200. mem_available_before_mib is the doctor's whole GiB x 1024.
